mapper.update: update t_flow_version set deleted=1 where flow_id=#{flowId}
mapper.select: select MAX(v.flow_version) as flowVersion from t_flow_info i inner join t_flow_version v on i.id = v.flow_id where v.deleted = 0 and i.flow_key = #{flowKey}

SELECT flow_id as flowId, flow_key as flowKey, app_code as appCode, flow_version_status as flowVersionStatus, id, flow_content as flowContent, flow_name as flowName, flow_type as flowType FROM t_flow_version WHERE deleted = 0 AND flow_version_status = 1 AND app_code = #{appCode} AND flow_key = #{flowKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
